questions.q_en: A light bulb working on a 18 V battery draws a current of 3 A. What will be the resistance of the bulb?
questions.solution_en:
The measure of opposition applied by any object to the flow of electric current is known as resistance.

Resistance Formula is R = V/I.

Here, V = 18 Volt and I = 3A

R= 18/3 = 6 Ω

questions.q_en: Identify the formula that represents Ohm's law.
questions.solution_en: Ohm's law states the relationship between current (A), voltage (V), and resistance (Ω ). The amount of steady current through a large number of materials is directly proportional to the potential difference, or voltage, across the materials. The formula that represents - V = A x Ω .

questions.q_en: What is the starting voltage of an AA battery used for home gadgets such as remote controls, small toys, and wireless kitchen appliances?
questions.solution_en: Triple A batteries are often used for small electronic devices such as TV remote controls, kitchen timers, graphing calculators, and bathroom scales. AAA batteries, like AA batteries, also measure at 1.5V, but generate less energy due to their smaller size.

questions.q_en:
The equation F= k(q1 x q2/q1) is representation of:

(Where F is the attractive or repulsive electric force of two point charges q1 and q2 and r is the distance between two charges)
questions.solution_en:
• Coulomb's Law describes the electrostatic force between two stationary, electrically charged particles.

• Formulated by French physicist Charles-Augustin de Coulomb in 1785, it states that the magnitude of the electrostatic force (F) between two point charges is directly proportional to the product of the magnitudes of the charges and inversely proportional to the square of the distance (r) between them.​

questions.q_en: Which of the following is NOT a conductor?
questions.solution_en: Hard rubber is not a conductor of electricity because it is an insulator. Insulators, like hard rubber, have high resistance to the flow of electric current. They do not allow electric charges to move freely through them and therefore do not conduct electricity.

options_en: Resistance of a wire depends on the length and density of the wire.
Specific resistance is the same for all conductors.
Resistance of a wire depends on the length and cross-section of the wire.
Specific resistance is dependent on the cross-sectional area of the wire.
questions.solution_en:
Resistance of a wire depends upon:

· Length of wire: Resistance is directly proportional to the length of a wire.

· Area of a cross-section of wire: Resistance is inversely proportional to the area of cross-section the wire.

· The temperature of the wire: Resistance of a wire is directly proportional to the temperature of the wire.

questions.q_en: An electric iron requires a ________ fuse to prevent short-circuiting.
questions.solution_en: An electric iron typically requires a 5-ampere fuse to protect against short circuits and overloads, ensuring safe operation.

questions.q_en: Which device is used to either break electric circuit or to complete it?
questions.solution_en: An electric switch is a device that can either interrupt or complete an electric circuit.

questions.q_en: Materials that allow electric current to pass through them are called ______.
questions.solution_en: Materials that allow electric current to pass through them are called conductors. Conductors have a high number of free electrons that are able to move easily within the material, allowing for the flow of electric charge or current.
